text:
maria: Quick check — I'm about to push the TF change that reduces recommender Deployment replicas from 6 -> 4 and adds podAntiAffinity. Wanted to see if anyone expects perf fallout this morning
ben: heads-up, any HPA config changes with that? we rely on burst capacity for traffic spikes
tim: HPA unchanged, minReplicas still 2 max 12. main risk is pod distribution with affinity. did you add topologyKey?
maria: yes setting topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname and softAntiAffinity preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution so we don't block scheduling
sophie: prefer a canary first? roll 20% of replicas then wait 15m to monitor latency/ooms
maria: plan was canary: rolloutPartition in rollout controller, but this is a plain Deployment. canary via replica partitioning with kubectl patch sound ok?
ben: patching replicas for a subset is hairy. we usually do a canary Deployment with label selector and traffic split in service. easier to revert
ops-bot: deploy-bot: reminder — deployments/recommender has probeFailureRate alarm configured in observability (alert: recommender.probe.fail.rate > 0.5% for 5m)
maria: thanks bot, I'll watch alerts. also wiring a KMS rotation for SECRET_RECOMMENDER_KEY — terraform change will rotate to new version and update k8s secret via external-secrets sync
tim: make sure external-secrets uses secretStoreRef that points to the new KMS ARN. last time the sync failed when we changed the key without updating the store resource
sophie: also add a pre-deploy job to validate secrets exist: `kubectl get secret recommender-creds -n prod || exit 1`
maria: good call. putting that into the CI pipeline now. snippet I'm about to apply in TF (shortened):
```hcl
resource "kubernetes_deployment" "recommender" {
  metadata { name = "recommender" }
  spec {
    replicas = 4
    strategy { type = "RollingUpdate" }
    template { ... }
  }
}
```
ben: can we set `maxUnavailable: 1` and `maxSurge: 1` for rollingUpdate? With 4 replicas that keeps steady capacity during rollout
tim: +1 to that. Also add resources.requests for cpu/memory — last rollout showed a pod scheduled on a smaller node and OOMed. set requests to 300m/400Mi as a baseline
maria: will add resources and the rollingUpdate params. i'll run the plan and post the plan link here
ops-bot: terraform-bot: plan for //terraform/prod completed — 6 changes (3 to aws_kms_key, 2 to kubernetes_manifest, 1 to external_secret). plan URL: https://r-infra.build/plans/7654
sophie: i'll watch the canary window. ping me when you hit apply and i'll keep an eye on tail -f logs and metrics dash
maria: applying in 5m. tagging @ben @tim @sophie for post-deploy smoke. I'll revert to replicas=6 if latency climbs >5% or error rate >0.2%
ben: sounds good. if anything flakey, enable fallback routing to smaller model instance pool (policy: low-latency)
maria: noted. thanks team :thumbsup:
